hero.title: It has read your paperwork
hero.lede: Agents quote your returns policy and your manuals, and tell you which line they used.

image.alt: A person reading through a printed document at a table.

ingest.title: Seven documents became 14 passages
lede: Fernway gave it six policies and one PDF manual. PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets and web pages are read and indexed on your machine, and nothing is uploaded anywhere.

scores.title: Every passage gets a score
lede: This is the real result for one question on the test day. Passages under the 0.50 bar are never used, so when nothing scores high enough the agent hands the question to a person.

threshold.line: Below **0.50**, it says it doesn't know
threshold.after: On the test day that happened once: a customer asked about electric scooters, which the documents don't cover.

unanswered.title: What happens to a question it can't answer

items.title: The customer is told
items.text: They hear that a colleague will answer.

items.title: The question is logged
items.text: It appears in Knowledge, under the questions your documents don't cover.

items.title: You write the answer once
items.text: Press Write an answer. It's used from the next conversation.

steps.title: Your documents
steps.text: Each file shows its status, its passages and how often it was cited.

image.alt: The Knowledge screen listing seven documents.

steps.title: Sources in a reply
steps.text: A citation chip on any answer opens the passage it came from.

image.alt: An answer with its source highlighted.

steps.title: Questions to answer next
steps.text: What the documents couldn't answer, with a button to write it.

image.alt: A question with a Write an answer button.
